title: Experiment 5 — staggered socket choreography

ownerLookVerdict.techniqueDecision: Do not adopt staggered socket choreography / the planting-wave composition as the Chapter 2 island-growth technique.
ownerLookVerdict.ownerFeedback: Not a big fan of how the island grows here, however the tree animation and the flower animations look quite nice.
positiveSignals: The bounded hero-tree growth animation is worth retaining as useful organic-motion evidence.
The bounded wildflower stage animation is worth retaining as useful organic-motion evidence.
ownerLookVerdict.scopeNote: The verdict rejects the overall socket-choreography growth-wave composition, not the individual tree or flower animation material. The arc remains active while the owner compares the other experiments.

technique.question: Can one hero track plus two reused support clips make the existing SVG island feel lively without an unbounded generated family, and when does the reuse become mechanical?

referencePlate.generatorConditioning: The plate fixed camera, root, socket offsets and acceptance inspection. It was not composited into or shipped as PixelLab output.
preservedAppLayers: semantic plate, wisps and UAT markers

clips.selectionNote: Three deliberate held duplicates reject visibly corrupted interpolation frames and expose the stepping cost of a bounded track instead of commissioning more poses.

frameSemantics: two coral blooms and cream bud retained
clips.selectionNote: Four explicit stage variants replaced an animation that repeatedly invented a ground platform.

registration.policy: Decode RGBA, select the authored root/ground-contact pixel, translate to the clip's one declared anchor, reject any translation that clips visible pixels, and emit a local versioned PNG.

appOwns: semantic state and normalized global progress
socket offsets and fixed world anchors
stagger schedule, duration, easing and holds
assetsOwn: transparent organic appearance for one selected stage

capabilityCorrespondenceAssessment.rule: Associate the first six app-ordered capability identities with the six support sockets. For higher counts, keep the six visual sockets and aggregate/rotate app metadata; do not generate a count-specific sheet or per-socket art.
capabilityCorrespondenceAssessment.tradeoff: The seam is controllable and cheap, but repeated fern/flower silhouettes can read like stamps before capability correspondence becomes legible.

budgets.runtimeAlgorithm: Seven fixed socket evaluations and one seven-item painter-order sort per progress update.
budgets.performanceAcceptance: No runtime PixelLab/network call; no more than seven SVG image nodes; fixed O(7) socket evaluation and painter ordering. This experiment records the bounded load but does not claim a frame-time benchmark.

prompts.heroBase: One ancient hero story tree as an isolated transparent game object, viewed from the same low top-down 2.5D/isometric camera as a compact story island. A single warm-brown trunk rises from one clearly visible fixed root contact at the exact horizontal centre of the bottom edge; broad asymmetrical crown, parent-first readable branches, clustered olive and emerald leaves with restrained warm-lime highlights, gentle windswept lean, roots gripping invisible ground. Whimsical premium storybook pixel art, hand-authored 16-bit sensibility, crisp pixel clusters, natural irregular silhouette, selective dark umber outline. No land, no soil, no coast, no pot, no shadow, no background, no text, no fruit, no flowers, no other tree, no disconnected leaves. Entire tree visible with generous transparent margin and the lowest root pixel centred.
prompts.heroMatureRepair: Remove only the grass and soil platform beneath the tree. Preserve the trunk, roots, branches, canopy, transparent background, pixel style and camera. Continue the visible roots cleanly onto transparency; no land, soil, coast, pot, shadow or background.
prompts.heroStartOriginal: A tiny first-stage hero-tree sapling on a 160x192 transparent canvas: one thin warm-brown stem, two olive seed leaves and a very small centred root contact, in the same low top-down premium storybook pixel style. No land, soil, platform, pot, shadow, background or text.
prompts.heroStartRepair: Continue the existing thin sapling stem downward into a tiny warm-brown planted root fork on transparency. Remove the entire round seed, pumpkin, soil slab, platform, rocks, ground and shadow. The lowest root contact is a narrow organic root centred near the bottom; all other pixels in the masked area are fully transparent. Match the existing premium storybook pixel clusters and selective dark umber outline.
prompts.heroAnimation: The planted sapling grows in place into the pinned mature ancient tree: the trunk and existing roots thicken from the exact same root contact, branches fork with gentle uneven timing, and the olive canopy opens in clustered pads. The two low seed leaves are absorbed into the growing trunk. Monotonic organic growth only; no wind loop, bounce, camera motion, rotation, fruit, soil, land, platform, or shadow appears.
prompts.fernStart: The first growth stage of one tiny woodland fern-and-grass tuft: only a short warm-brown root nub and two tightly curled moss-green fiddleheads emerging from one fixed ground contact centred at the bottom. Isolated transparent game sprite for a low top-down 2.5D story island, premium storybook pixel art with hand-authored 16-bit clusters and selective dark umber outline. No land, no soil patch, no grass platform, no pot, no cast shadow, no background, no flower, no text. Keep the entire sprout low and centred with generous transparent margin.
prompts.fernMature: One mature woodland fern tuft as an isolated transparent game sprite for a low top-down 2.5D story island. Exactly one fixed warm-brown root contact centred near the bottom; five naturally uneven moss-green and sage fern fronds uncurl upward and sideways with restrained warm-lime tips. Premium whimsical storybook pixel art, hand-authored 16-bit clusters, selective dark umber outline, natural asymmetry. No tree, no conifer, no land, no soil, no rock, no platform, no pot, no cast shadow, no background, no flowers, no text. Entire fern visible with generous transparent margin.
prompts.fernAnimation: The planted fern grows in place from the exact same bottom-centre root: two fiddleheads uncurl asymmetrically, then three more fronds open with small overlapping holds into the pinned mature fern. Monotonic growth only; roots never slide, no bounce, no wind loop, no camera motion, no rotation, no tree, no soil, land, rock, or shadow appearing.

knownFailureSignals: The hero clip has conspicuous held duplicates and a large sapling-to-trunk step.
Three identical fern silhouettes and three identical flower silhouettes may read as stamped repetition once all are mature.
The fern opens from curled fiddleheads to a broad mature silhouette in only four stages.
The wave can feel mechanical if the six support starts read as equal beats instead of story order.
Wildflower stages are curated variants, not one topology-consistent interpolation.
